body.objective: Prove derivative test fixture/import closure in the exact intended product snapshot without repeating existing B3 gates.

scope.owner: Main validation only; original Coder product directive6 remains active and unchanged
allowed_operations: New disposable base archive plus exact eleven files; existing v4 snapshot untouched.
Read/copy exact prior approved test/helper bytes only. No product/test edits.
Run the specified three native test modules once. Benchmark helper is imported as code fixture only, its guarded CLI/run_benchmark is not executed.

required_tests.environment: Pinned repository .venv/bin/python3; isolated cwd, PYTHONPATH=src, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; source-only third-party environment. No full-only HB add-ons.
gates: Exact eleven overlay hashes and base unchanged before/after; complete base-input inventory plus overlays.
Native fourteen unique test IDs, final testsRun14, exit0, no failures/errors/skips/expected failures.
Actual tests/midprojectrag module origins remain inside snapshot; imported benchmark helper exact snapshot file, not host fallback.
Record interpreter/version/platform/path/distribution multiplicity/import origin before/after and preserve existing .pth. No install/environment write.
Use isolated observation launcher with guarded main; record exact helper hashes and argv.

constraints: Not a replacement for running focused/adjacent/isolated/full or final review.
New failure/missing dependency => QUESTION; no extra overlay, assertion change or automatic repeat.
Prior approved derivatives keep separate attribution; no B3-new implementation claim.
body.design_acceptance: Actual /root/b3_resume_design accepted exact extra4 snapshot plus three-module supplemental native gate after independent /root/b3_final_critic scope audit; no product approval implied.
